background.overview: Coinbase Global, Inc. is a leading cryptocurrency exchange platform that allows users to buy, sell, and trade a variety of digital currencies. Founded in 2012, it has grown to become one of the most recognized names in the cryptocurrency space, providing a user-friendly interface and a secure environment for trading.
